title: Beef Stew
description: A hearty Norwegian-style beef stew made with nourishing ingredients.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef cubes, then remove from pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, cook for 5 minutes.
Add the flour, cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth, wine, and tomato paste, stir to combine.
Return the beef to the pot, bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to oven.
Bake at 300°F for 2-3 hours or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
